campus.title: Campus
campus.paragraph1: The Kutaisi International University Campus is located in the environmentally clean area of the city of Kutaisi, Georgia (Georgia's third largest city). The campus is spread out on a beautiful 160 hectares of land, surrounded by a forest with a river running through it. The campus is well connected and easy to reach. It is situated 25 km from Kutaisi International Airport and is only 3 hours' drive from Tbilisi.
campus.paragraph2: KIU offers modern and state-of-the-art laboratories, student facilities, cafeterias, libraries, co-working spaces, and an interactive learning management system — all creating a forward-thinking, technology-oriented educational ecosystem.

upv.title: Call Universitat Politècnica de València
upv.subTitle: CALL FOR THE SELECTION OF FULL-TIME/ASSOCIATE PROFESSORS FOR A WEEK EXCHANGE IN THE UNIVERSITAT POLITÈCNICA DE VALÈNCIA (SPAIN)
upv.description: The Kutaisi International University and the Polytechnic University of Valencia (Spain) agreed to cooperate on the exchange of students and staff in the context of the Erasmus+ KA171 program.
upv.toWhom: Full-time/associate professors of The Kutaisi International University
upv.whatFor: The selected lecturers will exchange academic experiences and explore future collaboration in common research fields.
upv.period: One week (five working days and two travel days) according to the working plan agreed with the UPV hosting Professor.
upv.eligible: Professors of the School of Computer Science
upv.info: The text of this call for applicants is published at the following links:
upv.applicationContentTitle: THE APPLICATION SHOULD HAVE THE FOLLOWING CONTENT:
applicationContent: CV in English
Motivation letter where the applicant expresses why he/she wishes to participate in this exchange

Lectures: Draft of the working plan pre-agreed with a UPV professor that should contain the overall objectives of mobility, teaching activity with a minimum of 8 teaching hours, and expected outcomes on the professional development and on the development of institutional collaboration.
criteria: The selection committee will consider the following criteria:
English language level: B1+ up to 3 points
Motivation letter: Up to 2 points
Applicant's curriculum vitae: up to 3 points
Proposed work plan: up to 4 points. This section will take into account the added value of mobility (for both institutions and for the participant) and the expected impact and result

grantProgram.title: Student Grant Program
grantProgram.description: Kutaisi International University is now accepting applications for the 2024-2025 Student Project Funding Program. The program aims to finance student projects that promote the development of student life and the educational environment.
grantProgram.submissionInfo: The project can be submitted by an active student, a group of students, a student club, or any student association.
grantProgram.fundingCategories: The program provides funding for the following categories of projects:

studentLife.title: Student Life Support Projects
studentLife.description: Organizing cultural, creative and sports events, competitions, hackathons, festivals, student clubs and other activities on the territory of Georgia.

educational.title: Student Educational Projects
educational.description: Organizing student research projects, quizzes, conferences and preparing for the Olympiads within Georgia, development/implementation of professional development courses, etc.

startup.title: Startup Projects by Students
startup.description: A team of KIU students with innovative startup ideas that enhance student life diversity and promote a culture of collaboration can submit a proposal.

criteria.title: Criteria
items: Any student of the University, regardless of citizenship, shall be able to participate in the activities carried out within the project;
The working language of the project should be either Georgian or English and Georgian, except for foreign language clubs;
The activity/event should serve to diversify student life at the University and create an inclusive environment, raising and developing students' academic and professional skills;
The student shall be eligible to participate in the submission of only two projects at the time, and the project coordinator may be present in only one project.

submissionRequirements.title: What is required to submit a project?
items: Project application (see KIU Student Project Funding Application Form ST_FORM_004), which will provide information about the project initiative group, project objective, project description and justification, project implementation plan and schedule, expected results, budget for the project;
CVs for the project coordinator and members of the core team;
The project can be submitted in both English and Georgian;
The project application can be submitted to the following e-mail address:

financialSupport.title: Project financial support
financialSupport.description: The project budget shall not exceed GEL 12,500, including income tax (20%). Projects that will have a co-financing component are encouraged.
financialSupport.contact: For questions and/or consultations, please reach out to the Student Projects Financing Program team at the following email address:

library.title: Library
library.description1: Kutaisi International University (KIU) features a modern and well-equipped library that provides a comprehensive collection of books and study materials essential for academic programs, as well as a diverse range of artistic and scientific literature.
library.description2: The library offers a wide range of electronic resources, including e-books, research papers, and study syllabi. Students have access to academic databases such as ScienceDirect, Scopus, Funding Institutional (Elsevier), Cambridge University Press, Sage Journals, MSP, The Royal Society, and more.
library.description3: The KIU library features a reading room, coworking spaces, computers, technology resources, and a printing room.
library.description4: Located in the academic building (K Block), the library is open Monday to Friday, from 09:00 to 18:00.
